name: Omnipress
author: omnipressteam

sections.description:
Power-up the Gutenberg editor with advanced patterns, custom blocks, and full site demos to build modern WordPress
websites—effortlessly.

With Omnipress, you get:
– Pre-built Patterns, Blocks, and Demo Sites crafted for instant use.
– Unique features like page transitions, site preloaders, custom query loops, and more.
– Deep integration with Full Site Editing (FSE) and WooCommerce.

🎨 Browse the Pattern Library
🌐 Explore Demo Websites
🚀 Launch a Live Preview

Why Omnipress?
– No code needed—everything is block-based.
– Responsive, SEO-optimized, accessibility-ready.
– Works with any theme and supports modern WordPress features.

Key Features

  • ⚡ Full Site Editing (FSE)
  • 📚 Pattern & Demo Libraries
  • 🔧 50+ Custom Blocks (Free + Pro)
  • 🛒 WooCommerce Support
  • 🎯 Advanced Query Loop Builder
  • 🧩 One-click Demo Import
  • 🌐 Preloader & Page Transitions
  • ✨ Glassmorphism & Scroll Triggers
  • 🔍 Product Filters & Search
  • 📈 SEO & Accessibility Friendly
  • 🔄 Regular Updates & Fast Support

  • Accordion

  • Dynamic Field Query
  • Content Switcher
  • Testimonials

  • Progress Bar
  • Taxonomy Query

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation
1. Go to Plugins > Add New
2. Search for “Omnipress”
3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation
1. Download the plugin
2. Upload the folder to /wp-content/plugins/
3. Activate via WordPress Dashboard
sections.faq:
Do you support the free version?

Yes, support is available via the WordPress.org support forum

Are tutorials available?

Yes! Check our YouTube tutorials

Minimum server requirements?

  • WordPress 5.8+
  • PHP 7.4+
  • MySQL 5.6+

1.6.6 – December 9, 2025

  • Security Fixes
  • [CRITICAL] Sanitized SVG file content with enshrined\svgSanitize\Sanitizer library
  • Enhanced Performance

1.6.5 – December 4, 2025

  • Security Fixes
  • [CRITICAL] Fixed XSS vulnerability in SVG file uploads
  • Added user capability checks for file uploads
  • Enhanced input sanitization across blocks
  • Performance Improvements
  • Added transient caching for block metadata and styles
  • Implemented script deferring for faster page loads
  • ~30% faster CSS generation
  • PHP 7.4 Compatibility
  • Ensured full compatibility with PHP 7.4+
  • Removed PHP 8.0+ specific syntax
  • Content Switcher Block
  • Fixed toggle functionality in frontend and editor
  • Modern styling with smooth animations
  • Improved accessibility
  • Code Quality
  • Centralized asset management
  • Refactored BlockStylesHelper for better performance
  • Fixed all SCSS deprecation warnings
  • Bug Fixes
  • Fixed fatal errors in BlockRegistrar
  • Resolved CSS generation issues
  • Fixed file warning errors

  • Added new blocks:
  • Remote Slider Container
  • Remote Slider Slides
  • Remote Slider Navigation (Previous/Next)

  • Active class toggler function

  • Fixed Gallery block issues

  • Compatible with Interactivity API
